notes: Tuesday iteration batch: iterations of current winners (Atria current, spend>=$300, ROAS>=1.8) and last-October seasonal winners.

concepts.angle: Emily RN testimonial → real Facebook comment thread
concepts.based_on: Emily RN nurse testimonial video RTGv1_B6 / 203_Iteration_UGC_OrthoStretch ($4,169, 2.93 ROAS)
concepts.headline: I have worn them up to 4 12s in a row at the ER.
concepts.prompt: Facebook comment thread on white. Comment 1 by "Emily R.", round profile photo of a smiling nurse in her 30s: "I'm a nurse with plantar fasciitis. Other shoes always hurt my feet after 3 12s in a row. I switched 2 years ago and I have worn them up to 4 12s in a row at the ER. I rotate between 2 pairs. So affordable on nurse wages." Under it "2d   Like   Reply" and a reaction pill with count "412". Indented reply by "Tasha W.": "Ordering mine tonight, thank you!!" with "1d   Like   Reply". Below the thread, a clean photo of the shoe from the reference photo on a light surface.
